slices.focus: Saira rebuilds a leaner, sustainable workflow from the summer setback with Peter's backing
slices.summary: Saira rebuilds the stalled workflow overhaul into a leaner version that survives thin staffing. She drops fussy forms, keeps only the busiest repeat shelves color-coded, and establishes a protected half-hour for repeat prep before school pickup. Peter visibly backs the new anchor point.
